prerequisites: Elasticity and advanced strength of materials (V12G380V01502)
Theory of structures and industrial constructions (V12G380V01603)
Having passed or being enrolled in all subjects from previous years.

learning_outcomes.text: Know the fundamentals of the resistant behavior of metal structures
Understand the criteria on which the Metal Structures Regulations are based, particularly for steel, manage them and know how to apply them
Achieve an adequate practical mastery of the dimensioning and checking of the main metallic structural elements

syllabus_topics: Modeling and analysis Ultimate limit states Serviceability limit states
Steels in sheets and profiles Steels in screws nuts and washers Filler materials Design resistance
Linear behavior models Section types Global lateral stability Initial imperfections Calculation by Finite Elements
Resistance of sections Resistance of bars
Deformations, deflection and tilt Sliding of connections
Typologies Stiffness Resistance Resistance of connection means

Structural analysis of models obtained from reverse engineering techniques for characterization and health monitoring of metal structures (Terrestrial laser scanner, Ultrasound and sonic impact test, Operational modal analysis, FEM, etc.) BIM/HBIM in intelligent modeling, analysis and calculation of metal structures Deconstructibility and eco-sustainable metal structures (reusable and reconfigurable)
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated from problem-solving (10%), tutored work (10%), an objective questions exam (40%), and a development questions exam (40%). To pass, students must achieve at least 30% of the total score from normative tests and 40% from problem-solving tests. If these minimums in the combined continuous assessment and final exam tests (c and d) are not met, the maximum final grade will be 3.90 out of 10. For the second opportunity, tests c and d will be repeated, consolidating the normative and problem-solving sections, while scores from parts a (attendance) and b (practical work) are maintained unless explicitly waived, in which case only c and d will be scored.
